Chat request that results in parallel tool calls in the response

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4`,
		Messages: []pkg.Message{
			pkg.Message{Role: `user`, User: &pkg.UserMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`"What is the weather in NYC and London?"`),
			}},
		},
		Tools: []pkg.ChatCompletionTool{
			pkg.ChatCompletionTool{
				ToolType: pkg.ToolTypeFunction,
				Function: &pkg.FunctionDefinition{
					Name:        `get_weather`,
					Description: ptr(`Get the current weather for a given location`),
					Parameters:  ptr(json.RawMessage(`{"properties":{"location":{"description":"The city name","type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"}`)),
				},
			},
		},
		ParallelToolCalls: ptr(true),
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Chat(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].FinishReason)
}
```
